name: Beaker Browser
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow primary updater classification: Beaker configures a GitHub release feed and schedules a daily update check only when the user setting enables it; Linux/source builds are explicitly excluded from auto-update.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in configuration.
Where electron-updater/Squirrel/install4j performs final verification, the external framework implementation is not vendored here.
